desc:
🌋 The lava is rising — grab an egg and run! 🥚

Steal eggs from the rocks, dash down the corridor past traps and carry your loot to your pen!

🔥 What awaits you:
🥚 Eggs of 10 rarities — Common to Divine
🐾 Pets with kg weights and mutations
⚡ Rain and lightning upgrade eggs — pets hatch heavier
🦖 Giant pets
🌋 9 zones, from Forest to Volcano — the lava keeps rising!
🏏 A bat and traps against thieves
👹 Flying bosses
🏡 Your pen grows with upgrades
💰 Pet income keeps piling up while you're offline (up to 8 hours)
🔄 Rebirths, quests and daily rewards
🍀 Server luck x2…x16
👑 VIP rooms
🌙 Day and night

Play, collect and become the king of pens! 🏆
